text: Assumption: Because the instantiation and lifecycle of the FVM are managed by ara::com, internal thread safety during concurrent requests shall be ensured by the plugin implementation — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Because the instantiation and lifecycle of the FVM are managed by ara::com, internal thread safety during concurrent requests shall be ensured by the plugin implementation — is this correct?
norm: because the instantiation and lifecycle of the fvm are managed by ara com internal thread safety during concurrent requests shall be ensured by the plugin implementation
assumption: Because the instantiation and lifecycle of the FVM are managed by ara::com, internal thread safety during concurrent requests shall be ensured by the plugin implementation.
rationale: SWS_CM_11272 specifies the lifecycle management in ara::com, but does not specify locking mechanisms for the plugin methods.
